changelog: Add GUIDE_zh.md: comprehensive full-lifecycle Skill Design and Practice Guide (design/writing/audit/publish/security-countermeasures/maintenance), superseding SKILL_zh.md as the authoritative reference
summary: Design better AI skills with proven architecture patterns. Helps you decide Workflow vs Agent, pick the right pattern (Prompt Chaining, Routing, Parallelization, Orchestrator-Workers, Evaluator-Optimizer), write clean SKILL.md files, and catch common mistakes with a governance-aware quality checklist. Based on design principles from Anthropic, OpenAI, and LangChain.
